summary: Wise Group plc filed a 6-K disclosing open-market repurchases under its previously announced buyback. From 07-11 September 2026 the company bought 800,000 Class A shares on Nasdaq and 914,573 on the LSE and other venues via Goldman Sachs International, all held in treasury. Disclosed prices ranged roughly GBP 8.86-9.39 and USD 12.02-12.57 per share. The program, announced 21 July 2026, targets up to GBP 405 million (about $540 million). No board recommendation or premium applies; watch execution pace, treasury overhang, and any acceleration or suspension signals.
